- HARDENING (advisory; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1): scripts/review_merge_train.sh | location: `_mt_merge_lease_conflict_unlabel_due`, the awk check on `MERGE_LEASE_SKIPS` (the line ending `$3 == "released_conflict" { f = 1 } END { exit !f }' && return 1`)
  PROBLEM: The check accepts a `<holder_pr>:<head>:released_conflict` entry for any 40-hex head, not only the head this tick tried to release. An old entry from an earlier head can therefore keep the label after a lost race in which the winner released the holder for a different reason.
  WHY: This needs several unlikely events in a row (the label removed while the old entry stayed in the record), so it is advisory only. Suggested fix: pass the holder head as a third argument from both callers (`MERGE_LEASE_HEAD` next to `tick_rel_pr`, `tm_h_head` in the multi-holder tick), and require `$2 == h` when it is a 40-hex SHA. About 5 lines change.

  PROBLEM: The awk check matches any `pr:40hex:released_conflict` skip entry for `p`, whatever its head. A stale entry from a previous head can keep the label after a lost race in which the winner released the holder for a non-conflict reason, spending the D6 one-shot for nothing.

That is one line in each of `_mt_merge_lease_tick` and `_mt_merge_lease_tick_multi` plus about 3 lines in the helper, about 5 in total.
